segments.name: Five Below
segments.description: Specialty value retailer offering trend-right, high-quality products mostly priced at five dollars and below across eight category worlds.
segments.evidence: We offer a dynamic, edited assortment of exciting products, most priced at $5 and below, including select brands and licensed merchandise across eight worlds: Candy, Style, Party, Room, Create, Tech, Sports and New & Now.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase merchandise at physical stores and online through fivebelow.com and mobile app, with e-commerce including shipping and handling revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: We also offer our merchandise on the internet, through our fivebelow.com e-commerce website and mobile app, offering home delivery and the option to buy online and pick up in store.
